title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pallavan leaves home after writing a farewell letter. When he goes missing the next day, Cheran and Pandian search frantically until Karthika reveals that he is at her house.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 76: A Reality Check from VJS
description: VJS hears out Ansar, Lakshmi Priya and Vasan on their separate issues with Muniyammal. He then puts Mukesh and Vasan on the spot over zero scores and a broken deal.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karikalan stands firm in opposing Pooja and Aadhavan's marriage over their betrayal. However, Saranya defies him and vows to unite the couple against all odds.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani longs for her mother's presence at the bangle ceremony as the preparations begin. Elsewhere, Vennila vents her displeasure at Rajeshwari over the festivities.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gandhimathi stops the scuffle sparked by Sakthivel, and the Muthuvel family leaves Pandian's house. Later, Senthil walks out in anger after Pandian blames him for the dispute.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu and Meena suggest a name for the event business, delighting Shruthi and Rohini. Manoj is stunned when Sakthivel reveals placing Devika's cash suitcase at the showroom.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sudar visits an emotional Vetri in jail as Abinaya suspects Sathish of framing him in Sandhya's issue. Meanwhile, they remain unaware that Divakar and Karna are behind it.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi conspires with Nalini and a nurse to repeat the DNA test and prove that Paraman and Viji are mother and son. Kalamma warns Rishi that Ilamathi is deceiving Viji.
